integrity: Proof contains a direct shortest-path classification and exact product enumeration, supported by independent graph-distance exhaustive checks; finite tests do not certify general claims.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted simple graphs with all terminal-pair distances at most two; no factorization claimed for terminal distance three or more; local clique computations may be hard; no smallest-counterexample claim; historical priority awaits independent confirmation.
title: Local clique factorization of semi-cutting sets at terminal diameter two
